prompt:
A minimalist recipe card illustration for a valerian sleep tincture. Flat-lay top-down view of a small dark cobalt-blue glass dropper bottle (deep midnight blue glass, soft highlights) lying slightly off-center (lower right) on a bone #F7EFE2 surface, with a black rubber dropper bulb and a tiny cream kraft label that reads simply 'Valerian' in clean serif type. Scattered around: a small cluster of pale-pink valerian flower heads on slender stems and one tan twisted valerian root piece. The composition breathes — at least half the image is clean empty bone-colored surface. No utensils, no saucers, no extra text, no liquid spills.

RENDERING STYLE: Clean modern illustration — flat base colors with smooth soft-shaded gradients. Glass bottle has gentle highlights, NOT painterly glints. NO watercolor bleeds, NO paper grain, NO sketchy lines. Cool dusk light from upper left casts a faint blue-tinted shadow below the bottle. Feels restful, slow, before-bed. Recipe card thumbnail — subject must read at small sizes.
